thread:
maria: flagging a spike  ~420 leads stuck in Inbound Queue with no owner for >8m. HubSpot shows enrichment_timeout and RR slot didn't advance. seeing lots from region=EMEA.
sam: can you paste one hs payload? a sample hs_object_id is enough.
maria: sample: {"hs_object_id":91234,"email":"lead+91234@acme.com","enrichment_status":"timeout","rr_slot":5}
sam: looking at workflow logs now. enrichment-service 502s during a 2m window. HS workflow configured `wait_for_enrichment` with 5m TTL, but the fallback owner step was behind a conditional that only triggers if `rr_slot==null`. because rr_slot is present we skipped fallback.
anika: that conditional seems brittle. if enrichment fails we should fallback regardless of rr_slot. propose: change condition to `on_timeout: owner=ops-fallback` and remove rr_slot gate.
jordan: agree. also map `owner_fallback` field to SF OwnerId on push, otherwise SF ends up with owner null. small transform: `lead.owner = lead.owner || lead.owner_fallback` before API push.
sam: rolling hotfix to HS workflows: `hsctl apply --file fix_inbound_fallback.yaml --workflow-id 312`. will canary. deploy-bot: started rollout hs-workflow-312 (canary 5%)
deploy-bot: canary ok, promoting to 100% :white_check_mark:
sam: workflow updated. added metric inbound_unassigned_rate and alerting at 0.5%/5m. also bumped enrichment TTL to 12m.
maria: counts dropped 420 -> 9 in 9 minutes. thanks. I've posted a brief update in #support for affected customers.
support: ETA on backfill for existing -> can you run a job to claim old leads to ops-fallback?
sam: yes running backfill: `scripts/claim_unassigned --since 2024-04-01 --owner ops-fallback`  estimated 45m. I'll monitor.
anika: creating MK-278 to track a proper fix: ensure RR state machine advances on enrichment failure, add unit tests for workflow conditions, and add integration test for HS->SF owner mapping. assigning to sam + jordan.
maria: can we report top 3 affected lead sources in tomorrow ops standup? also include latency window and number remediated.
sam: will add dashboard tile under Marketing -> Leadflow with breakdown by source and region.
jordan: noted, will also run a quick SF audit to catch any null OwnerId pushes.
maria: thanks team. follow-up in morning standup. :thumbsup:
